title: ospsuite.reportingframework 2.0.0
text: release includes changes introduced since version 1.0.1. Key differences vs 1.0.1: addMessageToLog(), captureLog(), writeTableToLog() now route ospsuite.utils::logInfo() / ospsuite.utils::logCatch(). setLogPath() now configures file logging ospsuite.utils::setLogFolder() logger appender. Logging behavior now controlled via setShowLogMessages() uses unified package-level setup. Added ProjectConfigurationRF wrapper delegates standard esqlabsR fields managing reporting add-ons separately. Added project migration helpers (upgradeToReportingFramework(), initProject()) keepEsqlabsRStructure support. Added configuration version stamping stricter handling read-/managed configuration properties. Added JSON snapshot/restore support reporting add-ons (snapshotProjectConfigurationRF(), restoreProjectConfigurationRF()). Replaced RmdPlotManager QmdPlotManager. Added mergeQmds() updated template/report assembly flows accordingly. Updated workflow ePackage templates match new rendering pipeline. ePackage export scripts now use updated template structure, reducing manual post-processing assembling final deliverables. Added DATACLASS = numericValues support scalar numeric configuration entries. Extended readObservedDataByDictionary() read numeric values. Added getNumericValue() typed scalar retrieval optional unit checks. Refactored dictionary mapping DataImportMap.xlsx sourceColumn/filter/filterValue expression-based valueExpr/conditionExpr. Added reference-scenario support sensitivity workflows. Added representative sensitivity analysis flow refactored sensitivity plot helpers. Updated PK demographic plotting utilities/captions improved consistency. Reworked inst/templates (including reporting-related workbook layout). Reorganized tutorial/extdata assets inst/extdata/Tutorial aligned workflow examples. Added template validity automation scripts data-raw/. Introduced expanded centralized message definitions R/messages.R. Replaced many inline strings reusable message helpers across plotting workflow utilities. Updated exported API docs man/ namespace exports. Updated README/pkgdown/vignettes adjusted tests cover new workflow, plotting, configuration behavior. exportWorkflowContext(), createAIWorkflowPrompt(), createAIPromptFromTask(), validateWorkflowForAI() provided early evaluation may evolve upcoming releases.
